authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant structural artifacts typical of AI generation. The most severe is the fusion of the bagel with the left pig's body; the bagel appears to merge into the pig's flesh/torso rather than resting naturally against it, creating a nonsensical anatomical hybrid where limbs seem to emerge from the bread. Additionally, the scale of the bagel is disproportionately large (nearly the size of the pig's torso), violating real-world physics. While the right pig is rendered with reasonable anatomical fidelity (confirmed by pose auditor with minimal risk), the left pig suffers from missing parts and structural collapse where it interacts with the bagel. The oil-painting style helps mask some texture defects but cannot hide the fundamental spatial and structural errors. These artifacts directly impact alignment (spatial relationship failure) and reduce authenticity significantly.
